skill.summary: Recreate low-budget AI video ad workflows using Nano Banana image generation plus Kling 3.0 video synthesis with dialogue, including prompt design, scene planning, cost control, and export handoff. Use when a user wants to produce a cinematic ad quickly (often in a few hours) with a small credit budget, or asks for a Deon-style Nano Banana + Kling pipeline.
